name: arcade-char_orc-armored-task51
prompt: A hulking orc brute in a wide, powerful stance, clad in a mix of rugged leather and intricate gothic plate armor. The torso features a polished steel breastplate adorned with delicate, deep-etched filigree, layered over a vibrant crimson tabard with shimmering gold-thread trim. The character wears heavy, riveted pauldrons, articulated steel gauntlets, and matching greaves over a worn leather base. The orc’s skin is a mottled deep green with a yellowish, muscular underbelly visible at the waist. The face displays a heavy, protruding jaw with sharp, small tusks and a determined, stoic expression. Finished with selective dark outlines to define the heavy plate segments against the softer cloth and skin textures, utilizing high-contrast shading to emphasize the metallic sheen of the steel and the depth of the musculature.
